title: Understanding k-Medians
text: In k-Medians, the cluster center is the median of the data points in that cluster. Think about how the median differs from the mean and how this might affect which points belong to each cluster.

title: Initial Cluster Centers
text: The initial cluster centers are at $$2$$ and $$7$$. Consider which points are closer to each center. Remember, the median is the middle value when the data points are ordered.

title: Assigning Points to Clusters
text: Which points are closer to the cluster center at 7?

title: Calculating Distance
text: To determine which points belong to the cluster centered at $$7$$, calculate the distance of each point from $$7$$. The points with the smallest distances will belong to this cluster.
